flows.title: 1 · Vocabulary gap
flows.blurb: Colloquial shopper language that never appears in the catalog. Stage 1 expands it; hybrid retrieval bridges the gap.

flows.title: 2 · Typos + price constraint
flows.blurb: Misspellings are fixed against catalog vocabulary and 'under $N' becomes a hard price filter.

flows.title: 3 · Navigational (brand) intent
flows.blurb: Brand-led queries: the intent classifier flags navigational intent, brand features dominate, and the brand diversity cap is lifted.

flows.title: 4 · Regional stock & BOPIS
flows.blurb: Buy-online-pick-up-in-store: only items stocked at (or near) the shopper's store may be shown. Compare unfulfillable results before vs after rules.

flows.title: 5 · Cold-start SKUs
flows.blurb: Brand-new drops with zero interaction history are retrieved from text+image+tabular content embeddings and still reach the page.

flows.title: 6 · Margin-aware re-ranking
flows.blurb: Same relevance, higher expected profit: the margin optimiser (weight 0.6 here) re-orders relevant items by E[profit] without crossing the relevance floor.

flows.title: 7 · Personalisation
flows.blurb: The same query for three different shoppers. User brand/price affinity features change the order; 'preferred-brand share' shows it.
